identity.name: Country Isles
identity.hoa_name: Multiple sub-HOAs (Garden Homes HOA - RSN Management, Village Homes HOA - Avalon Management, Patio Homes HOA, Executive Homes HOA, Captiva Cay HOA, etc.)
identity.notes: Country Isles is an established multi-subdivision residential community in Weston, FL 33326, consisting of eight subdivisions including Garden Homes, Village Homes, Patio Homes, Executive Homes, and Captiva Cay. It features a mix of single-family homes, townhomes, villas, and garden homes with lake views and mature landscaping. Governed by several sub-HOAs (Garden Homes managed by RSN Management; Village Homes managed by Avalon Management) rather than a single master association. The community offers a suburban, family-oriented lifestyle with access to lakes, green spaces, and proximity to Weston Town Center.

fees.note: Approximately $150–$200 per month reported for some single-family homes; varies by subdivision. Specific master HOA details unavailable in public sources; contact sub-associations for verification.

$375 per quarter reported specifically for Village Homes subdivision. Other subdivisions report $300–$500 per quarter. Transfer fees, capital contributions, and special assessments not detailed in available public sources.
$167/month reported in a specific listing. Fees vary significantly by subdivision and property type; exact amounts require direct contact with individual associations.

Quick Facts table: 'Association Fee Ranges: $117 to $291/mo' aggregated across active MLS listings in Country Isles sub-HOAs. Exact per-subdivision amounts not published on the page. Aggregator hoabulletinboard cites ~$150-$200/month, $167/month in specific listings, and $375/quarter for Village Homes; $300-$500/quarter for some properties. amenities.detail: Community swimming pools available in multiple subdivisions.
Country Isles Park with playgrounds and walking paths.
Trails and walking paths throughout the community.
Clubhouses or recreational areas available in some subdivisions.
Lake views in certain sections; potential for non-motorized water activities.
Established landscaping and well-maintained common areas across the community.
Playgrounds available at Country Isles Park and other sub-HOA areas.

Community amenities listed as 'a clubhouse, swimming pool, and spa / hot tub'. BEX Realty also notes some townhome sections (Patio Homes, Village Homes) 'demonstrating amenities such as a community pool, park, or kiddie's playground'. Florida HOA registry page lists 'Community Pool' as the amenity for the Garden Homes HOA (florida-hoa.net, retrieved same date).
'Country Isles amenities include a clubhouse, swimming pool, and spa / hot tub.'
'There is also a community park, a playground, a dog park, as well as walking or jogging trails.' Onsite dining venue: a picnic area.

Gating is partial, not uniform: 'The partly gated/ungated Captiva Cay, Garden Homes, Executive I, and Executive II subdivisions represent single family home accommodations...' HOA fees described as covering 'low-cost maintenance of campus grounds, security (where applicable), and limited community amenities'. Community is otherwise described as relying on 'spaciousness, privacy' rather than elaborate amenities.
'The Country Isles Master HOA does allow pets, however the various subdivision may impose their own pet restrictions, so check the individual listings for specifics.'

4.5-acre park in the community with a 0.3-mile walking/running trail, leisure playground, shelter/picnic area, and parking; wheelchair accessible. (City of Weston facility page westonfl.org was blocked to automated access; mypacer used as secondary source.)
'Golfers in Country Isles have the Weston Hills Country Club, a private club, right across the street from the community or the public Bonaventure Golf Club about five minutes away.'
'Just north of Country Isles is a Cliff Drysdale Tennis Center staffed by pros who provide expert instruction on 16 courts.'
HOA fee listed as including: Trash Removal, Water, Sewer, Pest Control. Unverified aggregator; confirm with RSN Management.

Trulia user votes: 93% would walk alone at night; 82% say it's quiet; 73% say it's dog friendly; 71% say parking is easy; 69% say kids play outside; 50% say it's walkable to grocery stores; 55% walkable to restaurants; 86% say a car is needed. (11+ Trulia users per feature.)

demographics.geography_level: Country Isles neighborhood, Weston FL (whole neighborhood; BestNeighborhood calculations from U.S. Census Bureau ACS 2020-2024 5-year estimates). Per capita income on same page: $70,965/yr; 69% of adults hold a bachelor's degree or higher. CONFLICTING/ALTERNATIVE FIGURES (different geography): point2homes (U.S. Census/ACS 2019-2023) reports for the small sub-area 'Harbour - Country Isles Garden Homes': population 1,644, median age 42, owner-occupancy 72.4%, median household income $117,373, 555 households, 615 housing units, median year built 1990 (https://www.point2homes.com/US/Neighborhood/FL/Weston-Miramar/Harbour-Country-Isles-Garden-Homes-Demographics.html); and for 'Country Isles - Waterford Landing': population 1,213, median age 42, owner-occupancy 72.4%, median HH income $117,373 (https://www.point2homes.com/US/Neighborhood/FL/Weston-Miramar/Country-Isles-Waterford-Landing-Demographics.html). No single census geography covering all of Country Isles was located; whole-community population unverified. City of Weston overall: median age 42.3, median HH income ~$139,825 (worldpopulationreview.com, retrieved same date).

demographics_history.geography_level: subdivision (Country Isles - Waterford Landing area only, not entire community). Median age 42; 48.3% male / 51.7% female. Race: 39.1% Caucasian, 5.2% African American, 5.4% Asian, 45.6% two or more races. Citizenship: 46.8% US-born, 32.3% naturalized, 20.9% non-citizens. 409 households, avg 3 members; 83.9% families, 16.1% individuals. Median income not stated in provided content.

proximity.nearest_name: City of Weston (for full HOA registry)
Publix Country Isles Plaza (store #1469), 1170 Weston Rd, Weston, FL 33326 - on the community's eastern border; has pharmacy, wine/beer, sushi, curbside

Weston Town Center (1675 Market St, per chamberofcommerce.com listing) - 'takes only a few minutes' from Country Isles; also Indian Trace Square 8-theater movieplex 'kitty-corner to Country Isles' per neighborhoods.com

Weston Branch Library (Broward County Library), 4205 Bonaventure Blvd, Weston, FL 33326 - on the community's western border (Bonaventure Blvd); shares building with Broward College satellite campus; serves pop. 65,672; built 1996

Cleveland Clinic Florida (Cleveland Clinic Hospital Weston), 3100 Weston Rd, Weston, FL 33331 - acute-care hospital with 24-hour emergency department (per mapquest.com listing of same facility); 316 providers. Broward Health Weston (2300 N Commerce Pkwy, Weston, FL 33326; phone 954-217-5700; not open 24 hours) is a closer urgent-care/specialty/surgery center per City of Weston community-resources listing (snippet).

Country Isles Elementary School (Broward County PS), 2300 Country Isles Rd, Weston FL 33326 (address per schooldistricts.us snippet; school confirmed on official page countryisles.browardschools.com) - 'in the center of the community' per neighborhoods.com. Tequesta Trace Middle School 'about a five-minute drive'; Cypress Bay High School 'less than 10 minutes away' (same source).
